4823-5232-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
4823-5232-8043.description:
Cast Clone Legion for free due to Vision, creating a token copy of each creature you control.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Timeless Witness token enters, it triggers, returning Clone Legion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

222-527-6495-8296.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-6495-8296.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Evereth twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.
222-527-6495-8296.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1418-2226-3977.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
1418-2226-3977.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Virtue of Knowledge.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Horned Kavu by paying its mana cost.
When Horned Kavu enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

3678-7084-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Retreat to Emeria triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

5007-6972-8095.description:
If Morselhoarder has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Morselhoarder has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Morselhoarder.
When Morselhoarder dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

4247-6431--5.description:
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When the persist creature enters the battlefield, Celes's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

3899-6529-7084.description:
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Curse of the Restless Dead triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Spawning Pit ability.
Repeat.

855-2021-2060-5902.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

261-4399-4770-6626.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and The Wind Crystal.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Suture Priest triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Suture Priest trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Suture Priest trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
261-4399-4770-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

3179-4399-4518-5070.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument.
Defiler of Faith and Oketra's Monument trigger.
Resolve the Defiler of Faith trigger, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve the Oketra's Monument trigger, creating a 1/1 Warrior creature token.
When the Warrior enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Angelic Chorus trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Angelic Chorus trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
3179-4399-4518-5070.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

4644-6478-7791.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding at least four mana of any color
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, targeting Arbor Adherent.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Tidewater Minion's ability, targeting Tidewater Minion.
Resolve both Tidewater Minion abilities, untapping it and Arbor Adherent.
Repeat.

430-1061-6222.easyPrerequisites: You haven't created any tokens this turn.
430-1061-6222.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Emissary Green.
You control at least eight permanents and/or have the city's blessing.
430-1061-6222.description:
Declare Emissary Green as an attacker, triggering its ability. Choose to vote for "Profit", causing you to create at least two token copies of Timestream Navigator due to Esix.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Timestream Navigator tokens give you the city's blessing.
Activate the oldest Timestream Navigator  by paying {2}{U}{U}, tapping it and putting it from the battlefield onto the bottom of your library, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
430-1061-6222.notes: Because you'll make at least two tokens each turn, you can skip steps 1 and 2 if you control at least two Timestream Navigators during a particular turn.

4050-6602--5.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Tromell.
Repeat.

2203-4657-5295-6871.easyPrerequisites: You control at least three mana-producing lands.
2203-4657-5295-6871.description:
Activate three lands by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Vorinclex triggers three times, adding {3}
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {4} and tapping it, untapping the three mana-producing lands and Thousand-Year Elixir, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Thousand-Year Elixir by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Magus of the Candelabra.
Repeat.
2203-4657-5295-6871.notes: You can tap more lands for mana each loop if desired. You'll need to pay an additional {1} in step 3 for each extra land tapped this way to untap them.

2999-3490-5231-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2999-3490-5231-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Impassioned Orator triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

3967-7084-7396.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
Quintorius, History Chaser triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1309-3617-5144.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Salvager of Secrets and exiling Ephemerate.
When Salvager of Secrets enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Salvager of Secrets.
When Salvager of Secrets enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

117-1618-2440-7376.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures that share a creature type with the tokens generated by Talrand
117-1618-2440-7376.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Charnel Serenade.
Charnel Serenade triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Talrand triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token.
Resolve Charnel Serenade.
Repeat.
117-1618-2440-7376.notes: You may start the combo controlling fewer that six creatures that share a type with the tokens generated by Talrand. If you do, you need to provide an appropriate amount of mana until Mana Echoes will start generating seven {C} or more.

774-907-6763.description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Selesnya Sanctuary from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it triggers.
Activate Selesnya Sanctuary by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Selesnya Sanctuary's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1169-1379-3259-5953.easyPrerequisites: Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness.
1169-1379-3259-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1169-1379-3259-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

2981-6972-7157.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Arcbound Lancer.
When Arcbound Lancer dies, its modular ability and persist ability trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting Arcbound Lancer's +1/+1 counters on another artifact creature.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Arcbound Lancer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will not have a -1/-1 counter on it due to its modular ability.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

11-2104-5864-7089.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Fire Lord Azula
11-2104-5864-7089.description:
Declare Fire Lord Azula as an attacker, triggering its firebending ability, adding {R}{R}.
Holding priority, cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Temporal Manipulation.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting the original Temporal Manipulation spell.
Fire Lord Azula's second ability triggers, copying Narset's Reversal, targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Temporal Manipulation spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Temporal Manipulation and returning the original Temporal Manipulation to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Temporal Manipulation from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.

2034-2811-2919-3490.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-2811-2919-3490.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Elas il-Kor triggers, causing each opponent to lose life.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

2981-3652-4053-6989.description:
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Ornithopter.
Cast Ornithopter from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

1978-5143-5709.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Forests.
1978-5143-5709.description:
Activate Rofellos by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Rofellos.
Repeat

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

549-1597-1978.description:
Activate Gyre Sage by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Gyre Sage.
Repeat

2921-5220-6535-6900.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Serrated Scorpion.
When Serrated Scorpion dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Serrated Scorpion from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Serrated Scorpion trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and dealing 2 damage to each opponent.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Cast Serrated Scorpion from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

3197-4017-4321-6890.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
3197-4017-4321-6890.description:
Gain life.
Herd Baloth triggers, putting a +1+1 counter on itself.
Herd Baloth triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent and causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

560-2292-4550-5572.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in hand.
560-2292-4550-5572.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Viscera Seer twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Dragon Appeasement triggers twice, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve both Viscera Seer abilities.
Repeat.

2558-3000-5727-6798.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, The Prydwen triggers.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Prydwen trigger, creating a 2/2 Human Knight and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

645-1267-5361-6797.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-1267-5361-6797.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Auton Soldier from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Auton Soldier.
Auton Soldier triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Auton Soldier
Repeat each turn.

1872-2916-5856.easyPrerequisites:
Composite Golem exiled by Hazel's Brewmaster.
You control a Food.
1872-2916-5856.description:
Activate a Food using Pippin's first ability by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a Food token.
Activate the Food tapped in step 1 using Composite Golem's ability by sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Repeat.

2034-2523-5560.notablePrerequisites: Rangers of Ithilien is your Ring-bearer.
2034-2523-5560.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Rangers of Ithilien, adding {C}{C}.
When Rangers of Ithilien dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Rangers of Ithilien that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Rangers of Ithilien token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Rangers of Ithilien token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Repeat.

1692-4659-5365.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Clue token.
Helm of the Host attached to Lonis.
1692-4659-5365.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Helm of the Host triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Lonis.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis and the Lonis token's second abilities trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Lonis trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on the token Lonis.
The token Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Resolve the token Lonis's trigger from step 2, putting a +1/+1 counter on the nontoken Lonis.
The nontoken Lonis's first ability triggers, creating a Clue artifact token.
Repeat from step 2.
1692-4659-5365.notes:
You may optionally target any other creature using one of the triggers to put infinite +1/+1 counters on that creature.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead sacrifice the Clues to their own abilities

372-1809-1987.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-1809-1987.description:
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Returned Pastcaller and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Returned Pastcaller trigger.
Resolve the Returned Pastcaller trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Ghostly Flicker.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Returned Pastcaller and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

1479-1671-2719.description:
Play Simic Growth Chamber.
Kodama of the East Tree, Sakashima of a Thousand Faces, and Simic Growth Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting Simic Growth Chamber onto the battlefield.
Sakashima of a Thousand Faces and Simic Growth Chamber trigger.
Resolve the Simic Growth Chamber trigger, returning it to your hand.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces token's trigger, putting Simic Growth Chamber onto the battlefield.
Kodama of the East Tree and Simic Growth Chamber trigger.
Repeat from step 5.

722-3153-4890.notablePrerequisites: Dack's Duplicate is a copy of Sphinx of the Second Sun.
722-3153-4890.description:
Cast Chronomantic Escape by paying {4}{W}{W}, causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
At the beginning of your postcombat main phase, both copies of Sphinx of the Second Sun trigger, causing you to get two additional beginning phases after this phase.
Move to your first additional beginning phase.
At the beginning of your upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself.
Repeat from step 3 one additional time.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Chronomantic Escape triggers, removing a time counter from itself and causing you to cast it without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Chronomantic Escape,  causing creatures to be unable to attack you until your next turn, and putting Chronomantic Escape into exile with three time counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more loyalty counters on it

1170-1177-4908-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Activate Narset by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to look at the top four cards of your library, then reveal Sensei's Divining Top and put it into your hand.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Narset.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

3693-4120-4565.easyPrerequisites: Walking Ballista has a +1/+1 counter on it.
3693-4120-4565.description:
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, targeting itself, but putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Vigor.
Activate Walking Ballista by removing a +1/+1 counter on it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat.
3693-4120-4565.notes: You may also target your other creatures in step 2 to put +1/+1 counters on them due to Vigor.

245-1742-2314.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
245-1742-2314.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Drake Haven triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 2/2 Drake creature token.
When the Drake enters the battlefield, Marneus triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1636-1936-2034-2204.notablePrerequisites: Scholar of New Horizons does not have summoning sickness.
1636-1936-2034-2204.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Kithkin Spellduster, adding {C}{C}.
Kithkin Spellduster dies, triggering its persist ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Kithkin Spellduster enters the battlefield, triggering Intruder Alarm, untapping all creatures.
Activate Scholar of New Horizons by tapping it and removing the -1/-1 counter from Kithkin Spellduster, causing you to search your library for a Plains card and either put it onto the battlefield or put it into your hand.
Repeat.

3490-4050-4743.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
3490-4050-4743.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing any other creature you control, adding {1}.
The creature dies, triggering Blood Aspirant, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.
